## Items needing a fix

### [53] and [54] PARTIAL, [51] PARTIAL (README use): "rootless Podman is unsupported"
Claims: analysis.md Not-recommended OpenHands: "rootless Podman is unsupported [53][54][55]". README.md isolation table: "Docker sandbox; no rootless Podman support | [51][54]". isolation-laptop.md table: "Not supported officially. Open issues [53][54]".
Sources: [53] reports only that a runtime-image build fails when rootless Podman has a single UID/GID ("my runtime image build fails when rootless Podman is limited to a single UID/GID"), and cites #5325 where "users reported running OpenHands with Podman through its Docker-compatible API socket". [54] says DockerWorkspace through a podman shim "starts the container" but "The agent cannot write to a mounted project directory (Permission denied)", and asks for a PodmanWorkspace. [55] is a Draft PR. [51] contains no mention of Podman. None of them states that Podman is unsupported.
Fix:
1. analysis.md: replace "rootless Podman is unsupported [53][54][55]" with "rootless Podman has open problems (runtime image build fails with a single UID/GID [53]; agent cannot write to mounted directories [54]) and the PodmanWorkspace backend is an unmerged draft [55]".
2. README.md isolation table OpenHands row: replace "Docker sandbox; no rootless Podman support | [51][54]" with "Docker sandbox [51]; open rootless-Podman issues, no merged Podman backend | [51][53][54][55]".
3. isolation-laptop.md OpenHands row: replace "Not supported officially. Open issues [53][54], PodmanWorkspace PR in draft [55]" with "No Podman support statement found in fetched docs. Open issues [53][54], PodmanWorkspace PR in draft [55]".
